baseline_models.mechanism: The supposition branch of حسب states the human's premise, while its reckoning and supervision branches turn that premise back on itself: he reckons that he can be released from reckoning.

activation_trace.role: Supposition supplies the mistaken mental premise posed by the question.
Counting and reckoning create a secondary accountability resonance inside the act of supposing.
Supervision and accountable management make release from oversight the challenged assumption.
Letting a thing go supplies the release whose possibility the question denies.

changed_reading.before: Does the human suppose he will simply be left alone?
changed_reading.after: Does the human's own reckoning presume that he can be released from reckoning and supervision?

baseline_models.mechanism: Letting go combines with the سدى image of advancing by reach or stride, so abandonment becomes permission to continue on a self-directed trajectory rather than a merely static lack of care.

activation_trace.role: Relinquishment removes the directing hand from the human's movement.
Advancing by reach or stride turns the resulting condition into unchecked forward motion.

changed_reading.after: The human is released to keep moving in whatever direction his own reach selects.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: يُتْرَكَ سُدًى, with سدى activated as the warp of cloth
baseline_models.mechanism: ترك as leaving something in a state and سدى as warp form a material model of a life left as parallel threads without the interlacing that would finish a fabric or organize an affair.

activation_trace.role: Leaving a thing in a condition makes incompletion the predicate of the passive verb.
The warp of cloth supplies an ordered but not yet interwoven material state.

changed_reading.before: The human is left without purpose.
changed_reading.after: The human is left structurally unfinished, like warp never completed into fabric.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier twin question joins supposition to gathering dispersed material and making it whole. That sequence gives the bare-warp baseline a bodily realization: not being left سدى includes not being left scattered or unfinished after death.

activation_trace.role: Leaving something in a state anchors the possibility of terminal incompletion.
Bare warp supplies the material image of ordered strands awaiting completion.
The repeated supposition branch marks 75:3 as the rhetorical twin of the focus question.
Gathering dispersed parts into one supplies the counteraction to being left unfinished.
Integrity and completion carry gathering through to a finished bodily form.

structural_cues: 75:3 and 75:36 repeat the construction أَيَحْسَبُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ أَن, while 75:3-4 specify bones, gathering, and precise forming.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated formula and the gather-to-completion sequence; I infer that the later question generalizes the earlier denied non-reassembly. A live alternative is that 75:36 concerns obligation while the parallel only supplies a resurrection proof.

changed_reading.before: Not left as an abstractly unfinished warp.
changed_reading.after: Not left as dispersed human material: the same rhetorical challenge promises gathering and completed form.

context_deltas.mechanism: ترك can preserve an effect after departure. The surah then supplies deeds sent ahead or delayed, a delivered report, a self that reproaches, and inward sight. The human is therefore not simply the object left behind; what he leaves becomes a persistent, self-attesting record that prevents his release.

activation_trace.role: Reckoning supplies the audit into which persistent effects are gathered.
Leaving an effect to remain enables the reversal from an abandoned person to enduring traces of action.
The self as the thing itself makes the witness inseparable from the accountable person.
Reproach for blameworthy action supplies an internal feedback mechanism.
Insight of the heart makes the retained record inwardly legible.
A report that arrives and is delivered externalizes the record at reckoning.
Advancing something ahead organizes deeds as effects already sent forward.
Deferral to a later time preserves the complementary residue of what was held back.

structural_cues: 75:13 moves from report to what was advanced and delayed; 75:14-15 then oppose self-insight to offered excuses.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies persistent-effect, report, temporal ordering, self, reproach, and insight images; I infer that deeds are the effects left by the human and that their persistence blocks his being let go. The alternative is a simpler sequence of disclosure without the object-to-agent reversal of ترك.

changed_reading.before: The question asks whether the human himself will be abandoned.
changed_reading.after: The question also denies that he can escape the effects he leaves: they remain as report and self-witness.

context_deltas.mechanism: The warp branch of سدى explicitly extends to weaving speech or affairs. The ordered sequence of gathering, recitation, following, and explanation thus activates a cognitive version of non-abandonment: guidance is assembled, sequenced, and made clear rather than left for the hearer to weave alone.

activation_trace.role: Leaving a thing in a state anchors the denied condition of unfinished guidance.
Warp and the figurative weaving of speech supply the organizing image for revelation.
Gathering dispersed elements into one supplies the first organizing operation.
Reading and recitation turn the gathered material into an audible ordered sequence.
Following in succession gives the recipient a directed response to that sequence.
Clarifying meaning completes the speech-weaving operation.

structural_cues: 75:16 forbids hasty tongue movement, and 75:17-19 answers with a four-step sequence: gathering, reciting, following, and explaining.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the speech-weaving scope and the ordered verbal sequence; I infer that this local provision exemplifies how a human is not left cognitively unprovided for. The materially live alternative is that 75:16-19 addresses a distinct recipient and should not define the generic human of 75:36.

changed_reading.before: The bare warp image indicates unspecified incompletion.
changed_reading.after: One concrete incompletion is denied: speech and guidance are gathered, ordered, followed, and clarified for the human.

context_deltas.mechanism: The human's attachment to the immediate is paired with his own act of leaving the later. Against ترك's branch of mutual withdrawal, the focus question now denies a projected reciprocity: the human may abandon the later, but that does not mean the governing relation abandons him or grants an unchecked path.

activation_trace.role: Mutual withdrawal supplies the reciprocity that the context exposes as the human's false projection.
Self-directed stride supplies the unchecked path expected after imagined mutual withdrawal.
Haste and bringing forward make immediacy the preferred temporal direction.
Love fixed in the heart supplies the attachment driving that preference.
Leaving a thing supplies the human side of the asymmetric abandonment.
The later term identifies what the human leaves while preferring the immediate.

structural_cues: 75:20-21 form an antithetical pair: loving the immediate versus leaving the later.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies temporal preference, attachment, leaving, and mutual-withdrawal images; I infer that the focus passive answers the human's active leaving with a denied reciprocity. The alternative is that the two uses of leaving are thematic contrast without a relational reversal.

changed_reading.before: The human expects impersonal freedom to move without direction.
changed_reading.after: The human mistakes his own abandonment of the later for a mutual release from the relation that still claims him.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus-only stride model imagines movement after relinquishment. The death sequence reverses every part of it: a limit is reached, separation is recognized, limbs are wrapped together, and the person is driven toward a sovereign destination. Motion remains, but neither its timing nor direction belongs to the human.

activation_trace.role: Letting go supplies the imagined absence of an external director.
Advancing by stride supplies the trajectory that the context forcibly redirects.
Arrival at a limit terminates the fantasy of indefinitely self-chosen movement.
Separation between joined things marks the transition the human cannot avert.
Wrapping one thing around another arrests the body's independent stride.
Driving and herding replace self-direction with compelled transit.
Sovereignty and ownership identify the destination as governed rather than open-ended.

structural_cues: 75:26-30 advances through terminal arrival, attempted remedy, recognized separation, bound legs, and a final destination.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the stride, limit, separation, wrapping, driving, and sovereignty images; I infer a deliberate reversal from free trajectory to compelled transit. A live alternative confines the sequence to bodily dying rather than extending it to the moral direction of the whole life.

changed_reading.before: The human is released to proceed under his own momentum.
changed_reading.after: The human reaches a fixed limit and is driven to a governed destination; his motion was never ownerless.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sequence contrasts unrealized verification and worship with denial and turning away, then answers withdrawal with repeated أولى. Activated through ولاية's turning-away and entitlement branches, the relation does not dissolve when the human exits; what is due or nearest intensifies instead.

activation_trace.role: Mutual withdrawal supplies the relation-ending model that the sequence denies.
Making truth effective in action identifies one rejected mode of maintaining the relation.
The specific worship practice supplies the second rejected relational act.
Attributing falsehood supplies the active repudiation paired with turning away.
Turning away supplies the human's attempted exit from the relation.
Priority and entitlement activate repeated أولى as a claim that remains due after withdrawal.

structural_cues: 75:31-32 balance two negated acts against two contrary acts; 75:34-35 then repeat أَوْلَىٰ لَكَ four times.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the balanced refusals, turning away, repeated form, and entitlement branch; I infer that withdrawal fails to become mutual abandonment. The live alternative is that أَوْلَىٰ is solely a warning formula here, so entitlement is only a secondary resonance.

changed_reading.before: Being left means both sides have withdrawn.
changed_reading.after: The human can turn away, but his exit does not cancel the claim upon him or cause the other side to withdraw.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing sequence repeatedly converts one state into another: measured generative fluid attaches, is created and completed, is made into paired form, and is set beside the capacity to restore life after death. The warp model becomes developmental: a process carried through earlier transformations is not abandoned as bare material before its final completion.

activation_trace.role: Leaving something in a state anchors the possibility that development might stop unfinished.
Bare warp supplies the material analogy for an ordered beginning awaiting completion.
Determining a thing and carrying its decree through makes the initial material already directed.
A pregnancy attaching and becoming established supplies the next retained state.
Measuring and proportioning supply directed formation rather than accidental persistence.
Integrity and completion mark formation as an operation carried to wholeness.
Making a thing into a state continues the staged transformation.
Effective capability links prior formation to the proposed final act.
Living spirit supplies the restored state toward which the final question points.
Loss of force and life identifies death as an intermediate lack to be reversed, not a terminal abandonment.

structural_cues: 75:37-40 uses a stepwise ثم/ف sequence from emitted fluid through attached matter, creation, completion, paired form, and revived death.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the successive states and branch images of determination, attachment, measuring, completion, capability, life, and death; I infer continuity between completed first formation and final restoration. The alternative is that the sequence proves capability without specifying the semantic content of سدى.

changed_reading.before: The human might remain like warp begun but never finished.
changed_reading.after: The human has already been carried through measured transformations, so death is not where that directed formation is left incomplete.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it reads سدى through stride and attaining a sought object rather than through a flat gloss of neglect. It remains anchored in the focus's سدى branches and is activated by the human wanting to rupture what lies ahead. Downstream prose should present it as a directional overlay, not as an exclusive lexical definition.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: يُتْرَكَ سُدًى as being released to advance and attain what one seeks

activation_trace.role: Letting go supplies release from an external check.
Advancing by reach or stride supplies the open runway.
Attaining what was sought turns unchecked motion into successful self-chosen acquisition.
Will and intention make the trajectory desired rather than accidental.
Deviation from right and rupture of a boundary identify what the desired runway is for.
The front or what lies ahead gives the transgressive trajectory a future-facing direction.

changed_reading.after: The human wants to be released onto an unchecked future runway where he can rupture limits and reach what he chooses.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain reading is surprising because it activates سدى as loosened unripe date clusters and maps that plant material onto embryonic development. It remains anchored in the focus branch and the packet's fluid-to-attached-to-formed sequence. Downstream prose should label it a material analogy for interrupted maturation, never a direct gloss of سدى in the ayah.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: سُدًى activated as loosened, unripe date clusters within the passive يُتْرَكَ

activation_trace.role: Leaving something in a state supplies the possibility of arrested maturation.
Loosened unripe date clusters supply the exploratory plant image of unfinished development.
Clear fluid ranging from a drop to a larger body supplies the first biological material state.
Pregnancy becoming attached and established supplies maturation beyond the initial fluid state.
Completed bodily form carries the material sequence to ripeness rather than abandonment.

changed_reading.before: The human is left in an unspecified useless condition.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the human is not abandoned like an unripe loosened cluster; initiated biological formation is carried toward completed form.

strongest_changes: The repeated question at 75:3 turns the focus into a resumptive denial of bodily dispersal and unfinished reassembly.
The report and self-witness sequence reverses ترك: effects left by the human remain and prevent his release from reckoning.
The death sequence reverses سدى as self-directed stride into arrival at a limit and compelled transit to a governed destination.
The closing formation chain strengthens سدى as bare warp: measured development is not abandoned at death before final completion.
The immediate/later antithesis makes abandonment asymmetric: leaving the later does not cause the human to be left.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet made the exact 75:3/75:36 rhetorical recurrence, the active تَذَرُونَ/passive يُتْرَكَ reversal, and the closing creation sequence simultaneously visible. The unusual سدى branches of stride and warp then produced directional and material readings that a generic 'aimless' gloss would hide.
remaining_uncertainties: The stride, warp, and unripe-cluster images are branch activations, not claims that one distant image exhausts the lexical force of سدى.
The revelation sequence may concern a distinct local addressee, so its extension to the generic human remains analogical.
Reading repeated أَوْلَىٰ through the entitlement branch of و ل ي is secondary to its possible force as a warning formula.
The reassembly and accountability mechanisms coexist; the trace does not decide whether one is the exclusive target of the focus question.
